t.zh: 在<level-ref to="seam"></level-ref>里，你算出了缝表。这一关把缝真的剪掉。
t.en: In <level-ref to="seam"></level-ref> you worked out the seam table. This level you actually cut seams out.

t.zh: 第一条缝你来找：先点最底一行里最小的那一格，再一行一行往上倒推。上一行三个候选里，缝是从哪一格来的？
t.en: You find the first seam: click the smallest cell in the bottom row, then trace back up row by row. Of the three candidates on the row above, which one did the seam come from?

t.zh: 剪掉一条以后，图片窄了一列，能量和缝表都要重新算。后面的缝交给机器，一共剪掉 8 条。最后和「直接压扁」比一比。
t.en: Once a seam is cut, the picture is a column narrower, and the energy and seam table have to be worked out again. Leave the remaining seams to the machine, 8 in all. At the end, compare the result with simply squashing the picture.

goal.zh: 找出能量最小的缝，把它剪掉。一共剪掉 8 条缝，让图片窄 8 列。
goal.en: Find the lowest-energy seam and cut it out. Cut 8 seams in all, making the picture 8 columns narrower.

how.zh: 第一条缝自己倒推：点最底一行最小的格子，再一行一行往上点。后面的缝可以让机器来剪。
how.en: Trace the first seam back yourself: click the smallest cell in the bottom row, then click your way up row by row. The machine can cut the rest.

body.zh: 图片窄了 8 列，两个字母一点没变形：缝都从不起眼的背景里穿过去了。直接压扁的话，每个字母都会被挤瘦。
body.en: The picture is 8 columns narrower, and neither letter is distorted at all: every seam slipped through unremarkable background. Squash the picture instead, and every letter gets squeezed thin.

body.zh: 这叫内容感知缩放（seam carving）。修图软件把一张横幅照片改成竖屏时，用的就是它：一张缝表，加上一次倒推。
body.en: This is called content-aware resizing (seam carving). When photo-editing software turns a landscape photo into a portrait one, this is how: a seam table, plus one trace back.

body.zh: 你在《视觉完备》里算出的边缘，在这里成了机器人的地形。两个游戏共用的不只是底层的代码，还有思路。
body.en: The edges you computed in Vision Complete became the robot’s terrain here. The two games share more than code underneath: they share ideas.

note.zh: 剪缝：从缝表最底一行最小的格子倒推，剪掉这条缝，图片窄一列。
note.en: Seam carving: trace back from the smallest cell in the seam table’s bottom row, cut that seam out, and the picture is one column narrower.
